exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the missing sentences as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
HAR BANDDA UCH QISM BOR:
  1) ODAT gapi (usually / often bilan) — Present Simple
  2) SAVOL (now bilan) — Present Continuous
  3) JAVOB — rasm va yordamchi so'zga qarab

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  Frank usually watches TV in the evenings.
  Is he watching TV now?
  No, he isn't. He is working on a computer.

JAVOB QOLIPI:
  No, he isn't / they aren't. + He's/They're + fe'l-ING.

RASM VA YORDAMCHI SO'ZLAR:
  1 — kompyuter oldida o'tirgan odam → work on a computer
  2 — stol ustida uxlayotgan odam (zZZZ) → sleep
  3 — plyajda qumda o'ynayotgan bolalar → play on the beach

items.textEn: 1  Frank usually watches TV in the evenings. Is he watching TV now?
items.answer: No, he isn't. He is working on a computer.
items.whyUz:
Kitobda BERILGAN namuna.
Rasmda Frenk kompyuter oldida ishlayapti.
'work ON a computer' — 'on' predlogi shart.

items.textEn: 2  Joe usually works very hard in the mornings. Is he working very hard now?
items.answer: No, he isn't. He is sleeping.
items.hintUz: Rasmda Jo stol ustida, 'zZZZ' yozuvi bor
items.whyUz:
Rasmda Jo ish stolida uxlab qolgan (zZZZ belgisi).
'sleep' → 'sleeping' (oddiy -ing).
Birlik ega → ISN'T va HE.

items.textEn: 3  The children often play in the garden. Are they playing in the garden now?
items.answer: No, they aren't. They are playing on the beach.
items.whyUz:
Rasmda bolalar bog'da emas, PLYAJDA o'ynashayapti.
Ko'plik ega → AREN'T va THEY.
'ON the beach' — plyaj yuzasida → ON.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct form of the verbs in brackets.
exercises.explanationUz:
ZAMONNI TANLASH — VAQT SO'ZIGA QARANG:

  PRESENT SIMPLE:
     sometimes, often, every day, every year,
     every Saturday, twice a week, in January

  PRESENT CONTINUOUS:
     now, at the moment

PRESENT SIMPLE — 3-SHAXS -S:
  Mother makeS, It snowS, She goES
  LEKIN: I have, We decorate, They drive (-s YO'Q)

items.whyUz:
'sometimes' → PRESENT SIMPLE.
'Nick' — birlik 3-shaxs → workS.
'work long hours' = uzoq soat ishlamoq.

'now' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
'I' → AM + having (-e TUSHDI).
'have lunch' = tushlik qilmoq — HARAKAT, -ing mumkin.

'every day' → PRESENT SIMPLE.
'Mother' — birlik 3-shaxs → makeS.
'make the bed' = karavotni yig'ishtirmoq.

'often' → PRESENT SIMPLE.
Ob-havoda ega 'it' — birlik → snowS.
'in January' — oy nomi oldida IN.

items.textEn: 5  We ............ (decorate) the Christmas tree every year.
items.whyUz:
'every year' → PRESENT SIMPLE.
'We' — ko'plik → -S QO'SHILMAYDI: DECORATE.

'now' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
'The man' — birlik → IS + feeding.
'to feed' = boqmoq (6-unitdagi 'feed them on milk').

items.textEn: 7  She ............ (go) to the cinema twice a week.
items.whyUz:
'twice a week' = haftada ikki marta → PRESENT SIMPLE.
'She' — birlik 3-shaxs → goES (-o bilan tugagani uchun -ES).

items.textEn: 8  They ............ (drive) to the beach every Saturday.
items.whyUz:
'every Saturday' → PRESENT SIMPLE.
'They' — ko'plik → -S QO'SHILMAYDI: DRIVE.

items.textEn: 9  Diane ............ (listen) to music at the moment.
items.whyUz:
'at the moment' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
'Diane' — birlik → IS + listening.
'listen TO music' — 'to' shart.

'now' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
'My sister' — birlik → IS + cleaning.

exercises.explanationUz:
HAR JUFTLIKDA FAQAT BITTASI TO'G'RI.

MUHIM QOIDALAR:

  1) CHASTOTA RAVISHLARI (always, usually, often,
     sometimes, never) — PRESENT SIMPLE bilan keladi:
        Bob NEVER SWIMS  (to'g'ri)
        Bob is never swimming  (XATO)

  2) 'every day/morning' — PRESENT SIMPLE:
        Phil GETS UP every morning  (to'g'ri)

  3) 'in your free time' — ODAT → PRESENT SIMPLE:
        What DO you DO in your free time?  (to'g'ri)

  4) HOZIR sodir bo'layotgan ish — PRESENT CONTINUOUS:
        Dad IS WATCHING the game now.
        The baby IS SLEEPING.  ('Be quiet!' — hozir uxlayapti)

KITOBDA BERILGAN: 1a to'g'ri.

options: a. Dad is watching the football game now.
b. Dad watches the football game now.
items.answer: a. Dad is watching the football game now.
items.whyUz: Kitobda BERILGAN javob. 'now' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

options: a. Do the dancers practise every day?
b. Are the dancers practising every day?
items.answer: a. Do the dancers practise every day?
items.whyUz:
'every day' → PRESENT SIMPLE savoli: DO + ega + fe'l?
'to practise' = mashq qilmoq (britancha yozilishi; amerikacha: practice).

options: b. Bob never swims in the sea.
a. Bob is never swimming in the sea.
items.answer: b. Bob never swims in the sea.
items.whyUz:
'never' — CHASTOTA ravishi → PRESENT SIMPLE.
'Bob' — birlik 3-shaxs → swimS.
'never' fe'ldan OLDIN turadi.

options: b. Phil gets up every morning at 7:00.
a. Phil is getting up every morning at 7:00.
items.answer: b. Phil gets up every morning at 7:00.
items.whyUz:
'every morning' → PRESENT SIMPLE.
'Phil' — birlik 3-shaxs → getS up.
'at 7:00' — aniq soat oldida AT.

options: a. What do you do in your free time?
b. What are you doing in your free time?
items.answer: a. What do you do in your free time?
items.whyUz:
'in your free time' = bo'sh vaqtingizda — ODAT → PRESENT SIMPLE.
'What DO you DO ...?' — birinchi 'do' yordamchi, ikkinchisi asosiy fe'l.

options: a. Be quiet! The baby is sleeping.
b. Be quiet! The baby sleeps.
items.answer: a. Be quiet! The baby is sleeping.
items.whyUz:
'Be quiet!' (Jim bo'l!) — chaqaloq AYNAN HOZIR uxlayapti
→ PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
'The baby sleeps' — umumiy odat bo'lardi, bu yerda mos emas.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct form of the verbs in the list.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT: leave, go, clean, get, play

MATN (to'ldirilgan holda):
  Every day my father GOES to work. He GETS up early and he
  LEAVES home at about 8:00. My sister and I GO to school
  every morning. Mother usually CLEANS the house. She
  sometimes GOES shopping. The dog PLAYS in the garden in
  the mornings.

O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  Har kuni dadam ishga boradi. U erta turadi va taxminan
  soat 8 da uydan chiqadi. Singlim bilan men har kuni ertalab
  maktabga boramiz. Oyim odatda uyni tozalaydi. U ba'zan
  xaridga boradi. It ertalablari bog'da o'ynaydi.

BUTUN MATN PRESENT SIMPLE'DA —
'Every day', 'usually', 'sometimes' shuni ko'rsatadi.

DIQQAT — 'go' IKKI MARTA ISHLATILADI:
  goes to work (1-band)  va  goes shopping (6-band)

EGA BIRLIKMI YOKI KO'PLIKMI:
  my father, Mother, She, The dog → fe'l + S
  My sister and I (= we)          → fe'l ASOS shaklida

items.textEn: Every day my father 1) ............ to work.
items.hintUz: 'to work' bilan keladigan fe'l; ega birlik
items.whyUz:
'go to work' = ishga bormoq.
'my father' — birlik 3-shaxs → goES (-o → -ES).

'get up' = uyg'onmoq, turmoq.
'He' — birlik → getS.

'leave home' = uydan chiqmoq.
'he' — birlik → leaveS.
DIQQAT: 'leave home' — 'from' KERAK EMAS.

items.textEn: My sister and I 4) ............ to school every morning.
items.whyUz:
'My sister and I' = WE → ko'plik → -S QO'SHILMAYDI: GO.
'go to school' = maktabga bormoq (artiklsiz).

'clean the house' = uyni tozalamoq.
'Mother' — birlik 3-shaxs → cleanS.

'go shopping' = xaridga bormoq.
'She' — birlik → goES.
DIQQAT: 'go' bu mashqda IKKI marta ishlatiladi.

items.textEn: The dog 7) ............ in the garden in the mornings.
items.whyUz:
'play in the garden' = bog'da o'ynamoq.
'The dog' — birlik → playS (unli + y → faqat -S).
'in the mornings' — ko'plik: har kuni ertalab.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the correct tense.
exercises.explanationUz:
MATN (to'ldirilgan holda):
  Today it's Sunday. We are all at home. Father IS SITTING on
  the sofa. He IS READING a newspaper. Mother ISN'T CLEANING
  the house. She IS TALKING on the phone. My sister IS HAVING
  tea and I AM WATCHING TV. The dog ISN'T PLAYING in the
  garden. It IS SLEEPING.

O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  Bugun yakshanba. Hammamiz uydamiz. Dadam divanda o'tiribdi.
  U gazeta o'qiyapti. Oyim uyni tozalamayapti. U telefonda
  gaplashayapti. Singlim choy ichayapti, men esa televizor
  ko'ryapman. It bog'da o'ynamayapti. U uxlayapti.

BUTUN MATN PRESENT CONTINUOUS'DA —
'Today' va rasmda hozirgi manzara ko'rsatilgan.

11a VA 11b NI SOLISHTIRING:
  11a — HAR KUNI nima qilishadi (odat) → Present Simple
  11b — BUGUN nima qilishayapti (hozir) → Present Continuous

DIQQAT — INKOR SHAKLLAR:
  10-band: (not/clean) → ISN'T CLEANING
  14-band: (not/play)  → ISN'T PLAYING

items.whyUz:
'Father' — birlik → IS + sitting.
'sit' → 'sitting' (t IKKILANADI).
'ON the sofa' — divan yuzasida → ON.

'He' — birlik → IS + reading (oddiy -ing).
'a newspaper' = gazeta.

'not' berilgan → INKOR: IS NOT = ISN'T + cleaning.
11a-mashqda oyim odatda uyni tozalaydi, LEKIN bugun tozalamayapti.

'She' — birlik → IS + talking.
'talk ON the phone' = telefonda gaplashmoq ('on' shart).

'have tea' = choy ichmoq — HARAKAT → -ing mumkin.
'My sister' — birlik → IS + having (-e TUSHDI).

'I' → AM + watching (oddiy -ing).
DIQQAT: 'watch TV' — artikl KERAK EMAS.

'not' berilgan → INKOR: ISN'T + playing.
11a-mashqda it odatda bog'da o'ynaydi, LEKIN bugun o'ynamayapti.

'It' (= the dog) — birlik → IS + sleeping.
Rasmda it polda uxlab yotibdi.

groups.ruleUz: Chastota ravishlari — DOIM Present Simple bilan
groups.explanationUz: Bu so'zlar bilan Present Continuous ISHLATILMAYDI.

patterns.exampleEn: Frank usually watches TV in the evenings. Is he watching TV now? — No, he isn't. He is working on a computer.
patterns.exampleUz: Frenk odatda kechqurun televizor ko'radi. Hozir televizor ko'ryaptimi? — Yo'q. U kompyuterda ishlayapti.
patterns.explanationUz: Bu qolip ikki zamon farqini eng aniq ko'rsatadi.

patterns.exampleEn: Bob never swims in the sea. Nick sometimes works long hours.
patterns.exampleUz: Bob hech qachon dengizda suzmaydi. Nik ba'zan uzoq ishlaydi.
patterns.explanationUz: Chastota ravishi FE'LDAN OLDIN turadi ('be' dan keyin).

patterns.exampleEn: Mother isn't cleaning the house. The dog isn't playing in the garden.
patterns.exampleUz: Oyim uyni tozalamayapti. It bog'da o'ynamayapti.
patterns.explanationUz: Qavsda 'not' berilgan bo'lsa — inkor shakl kerak.

patterns.formula: Be quiet! + The baby IS SLEEPING.
patterns.exampleEn: Be quiet! The baby is sleeping.
patterns.explanationUz: Buyruqdan keyin AYNI PAYTDAGI holat aytiladi → Present Continuous.

patterns.formula: What DO you DO in your free time?  (odat savoli)
patterns.exampleEn: What do you do in your free time?
patterns.explanationUz:
Birinchi 'do' — yordamchi, ikkinchisi — asosiy fe'l.
'What are you doing?' — HOZIR nima qilayotganini so'raydi.

patterns.formula: My sister and I = WE → fe'l ASOS shaklida.
patterns.exampleEn: My sister and I go to school every morning.
patterns.exampleUz: Singlim bilan men har kuni ertalab maktabga boramiz.
patterns.explanationUz: '... and I' bilan tugagan ega DOIM ko'plik → -S QO'SHILMAYDI.
